def: to be a public servant, i.e. (by analogy) to perform religious or charitable functions (worship, obey, relieve)

occurrences.text: As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Ghost said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.
It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
And every priest standeth daily ministering and offering oftentimes the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
